Customs

कस्टम ब्रोकरी लाइसेंस

A government-issued authorization allowing a person or company to act as a customs broker, facilitating import/export clearance and ensuring regulatory compliance.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A government-issued authorization allowing a person or company to act as a customs broker, facilitating import/export clearance and ensuring regulatory compliance.

Operational example

A valid broker license is required to file customs entries and represent clients before customs authorities.
